Maximum-likelihood estimation for a general jump model

Source: R/general_ga_fit.R
general_ga_fit.Rd

Dimension-generic analogue of sird_ga_fit(). All explicit compartments except one (free_init) are held fixed at start's values for the initial condition; by default only the observed compartment's initial fraction is estimated, with all others fixed (mirroring sird_ga_fit()'s treatment of r0).

Usage

general_ga_fit(
  y,
  N,
  model,
  obs_compartment,
  Delta = 1,
  start,
  free_init = obs_compartment,
  p_max = 0.999,
  n_sub = 10L,
  Q0_diag = 1e-08,
  control = list(maxit = 3000, reltol = 1e-10),
  hessian = FALSE
)

Arguments

y, N, Delta

As in sird_ga_fit().

model

A jump_model.

obs_compartment

Name of the observed compartment.

start

Named list with one entry per rate parameter, one entry per compartment in model$compartments (the initial condition), p and tau2.

free_init

Character vector of compartment names whose initial fraction is estimated (default: just obs_compartment); all other compartments are held fixed at their start value, and the "susceptible-like" first compartment is always treated as 1 - sum( other explicit compartments) so the initial condition stays on the simplex.

p_max, n_sub, Q0_diag, control, hessian

As in sird_ga_fit().
